THE PERSON BEHIND THE PATTERNS

Good teaching.
Beautiful making.

Gracy founded ISew to share the skills behind clothes that fit and feel right. Her teaching brings measurement, drafting and construction together, one considered step at a time.

From Nigeria to Ghana and Kenya, the academy is a place to ask questions, practise your craft and develop a way of making that is your own.

Get to know the academy ↗
